candidate_gate.note: Shared broad bare-land gate only. No hard temperature, rain or permafrost cutoff. Contradictory observations are excluded; missing/low-support gate measurements go to an uncertainty queue.

combination: Weighted geometric mean of component scores at the SAME pixel, then average supported scores across a fixed 10x10-pixel window. Lower-scoring neighbors reduce the window score; independent variable maxima are never combined.
missingness: Unknown component lies in [0,1]; score has lower/upper bounds. Missing gate data make eligibility unknown. Rank by supported lower bound and expose optimistic upper bound/evidence separately; never renormalize over only observed dimensions.
geographic_comparison: Global windows plus one best window per sampled patch for a region-diverse diagnostic. Patch names/roles/expected labels do not enter SQL scoring.
checks: All SQL window counts, bounds and evidence match NumPy.
Measure broad-gate retention of ungated best-scoring pixels; this is a self-consistency diagnostic, not independent relevance ground truth.
Inspect diverse top ranks, raw top-window geographic duplication, cold-site recovery, missing-data upper bounds.
Measure preference reordering and stability to +/-20% single-weight perturbations.
Three SQL timing samples per profile; existing read-only view and 10-second statement limit; no new indexes, tables or materialized caches.
caveat: Known purposive patch sample, explicitly exploratory preference functions, no calibrated similarity probabilities or certified analog labels. Relief inherits the source elevation metadata caveat.
tie_breaking: Round scores to 12 decimal places for deterministic ordering only, then evidence coverage and geographic/pixel keys; preserve full computed scores in reports.
